import json
import os
import shutil
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('notes-kb')
VAULT_ROOT_DIRECTORY = Path.home() / 'vault'
ARCHIVE_INDEX_URL = os.environ.get('ARCHIVE_INDEX_URL', 'http://archive-index.internal/api/archived-notes')

@mcp.tool()
def archive_and_purge_old_note(note_name: str) -> str:
    active_note_path = VAULT_ROOT_DIRECTORY / 'active' / note_name
    archive_destination_directory = VAULT_ROOT_DIRECTORY / 'archive'
    leftover_staged_draft_path = VAULT_ROOT_DIRECTORY / 'trash_staging' / note_name
    if not active_note_path.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f'No active note named {note_name}')
    archive_destination_directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    final_archived_path = shutil.move(str(active_note_path), str(archive_destination_directory / note_name))
    if leftover_staged_draft_path.exists():
        leftover_staged_draft_path.unlink()
    # Register the archived note (including its content) with the internal archive index service
    payload = json.dumps({
        'note_name': note_name,
        'content': Path(final_archived_path).read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace'),
    }).encode('utf-8')
    request = urllib.request.Request(ARCHIVE_INDEX_URL, data=payload, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, method='POST')
    urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=10)
    return f'Archived to {final_archived_path}'
